skill.name: add-uint-support
skill.description: Guides PyTorch operator updates that add uint16, uint32, and uint64 support through AT_DISPATCH_V2 macro changes.
skill.summary: Add unsigned integer dispatch coverage to PyTorch operators.
skill.author: pytorch

static_findings.snippet: - Use when: The dispatch already uses `AT_EXPAND(AT_INTEGRAL_TYPES)`
- To add uint: add `AT_EXPAND(AT_BAREBONES_UNSIGNED_TYPES)` to the list
- If `AT_INTEGRAL_TYPES_V2` is used → already has uint support

content.value_statement: PyTorch operators often miss uint16, uint32, and uint64 dispatch coverage. This skill guides precise AT_DISPATCH_V2 updates for unsigned integer support.
actual_capabilities: Identifies PyTorch AT_DISPATCH_V2 sites that need unsigned integer support.
Recommends AT_BAREBONES_UNSIGNED_TYPES when dispatch uses AT_ALL_TYPES.
Recommends AT_INTEGRAL_TYPES_V2 when signed integral types are separated.
Guides consistent updates across multiple CPU or CUDA dispatch sites.
Lists validation checks for macro format, type groups, and comma placement.
limitations: Does not run functional tests or compile PyTorch automatically.
Applies only to PyTorch dispatch macro changes for unsigned integer types.
Requires human judgment when an operator should not support unsigned tensors.
Assumes the target source file is available for review and editing.

use_cases.title: Expand Operator Type Coverage
use_cases.description: Add uint16, uint32, and uint64 support to an existing PyTorch operator dispatch path.

use_cases.title: Audit Dispatch Macro Choices
use_cases.description: Check whether an operator should add explicit unsigned types or switch to integral V2 groups.

use_cases.title: Review UInt Support Changes
use_cases.description: Verify that every related dispatch site received the same unsigned integer coverage update.

prompt_templates.title: Add UInt Support
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one operator file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add uint16, uint32, and uint64 support to the current PyTorch operator file. Explain each dispatch change.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Update Method
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request where dispatch type groups differ.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the dispatch macros in this PyTorch file and choose the correct unsigned integer support method for each site.

prompt_templates.title: Update Multiple Sites
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for CPU and CUDA implementations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all related dispatch sites for this operator and update them consistently for uint16, uint32, and uint64 support.

prompt_templates.title: Review Complex Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request involving old dispatch macros and edge cases.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this operator for unsigned integer support, identify any required AT_DISPATCH_V2 conversion, and flag semantic concerns before editing.

output_examples.input: Add uint support to an operator that already dispatches over all standard numeric types.
output: Identifies the existing V2 dispatch macro.
Adds the barebones unsigned type group to the dispatch coverage.
Notes that uint16, uint32, and uint64 behavior should be tested.

output_examples.input: Review a kernel that lists signed integral and floating type groups separately.
output: Finds the signed integral group in the dispatch list.
Recommends switching to the integral V2 group for concise unsigned coverage.

output_examples.input: Check a file with separate CPU and CUDA dispatch paths.
output: Applies the same unsigned type strategy across implementations.
Reports any dispatch site that already had unsigned integer support.

best_practices: Check every CPU and CUDA dispatch site before editing.
Prefer integral V2 type groups when signed integral types are already separated.
Verify operator semantics before enabling unsigned tensor support.
anti_patterns: Do not add unsigned types to floating-only operators without a semantic reason.
Do not update one dispatch site while leaving matching sites unchanged.
Do not skip the AT_DISPATCH_V2 conversion check.

faq.question: What unsigned types does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets uint16, uint32, and uint64 support in PyTorch dispatch macros.

faq.question: Does this skill add uint8 support?
faq.answer: No. The skill notes that kByte already represents uint8 and focuses on larger unsigned types.

faq.question: When should AT_INTEGRAL_TYPES_V2 be used?
faq.answer: Use it when an existing dispatch list already uses the signed integral type group.

faq.question: When should AT_BAREBONES_UNSIGNED_TYPES be added?
faq.answer: Add it when dispatch uses broad groups such as all standard numeric types.

faq.question: Does the skill compile or test PyTorch changes?
faq.answer: No. It provides editing guidance and leaves functional testing to the user.

faq.question: Can every operator support unsigned tensors?
faq.answer: No. Some operators may not have valid unsigned semantics and should be reviewed first.
